result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Functions Operations Manager for our client in Northcote, Victoria. This role is responsible for managing hospitality function operations, overseeing event delivery, ensuring operational excellence, and driving exceptional guest experiences across venues and external catering operations.

Job Description

•	Manage the day-to-day operations of function facilities at all venues and external catering functions, ensuring seamless delivery and high-quality guest experiences.

•	Develop and implement standard operating procedures for function execution across all venues, ensuring consistency in service, efficiency and compliance with hospitality standards.

•	Collaborate with event coordinators, senior management, and operational teams to ensure function execution aligns with business strategies, client expectations, and venue capabilities.

•	Ensure operational consistency and financial performance by auditing and refining function workflows, service delivery and venue capabilities.

•	Conduct venue performance reviews to assess function profitability and identify areas for improvement.

•	Ensure all venues remain compliant with hospitality regulations, licensing laws and risk management policies.

•	Review incident summary reports to determine areas of improvement for function safety and security.

•	Act as the primary escalation point for customer complaints and member queries, resolving concerns professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.

•	Collaborate with Head Chefs and sommeliers to develop menus and function packages that align with each venue’s identity, accommodate dietary requirements and maintain profitability.

•	Produce and analyse operational reports relevant to venue functions and provide advice on operational matters.

•	Monitor financial performance by managing budgets, forecasting revenue and analysing profitability for function operations, including food, beverage, labour and other costs.

•	Work closely with senior management and other departments to align operational strategies, enhance guest experience and achieve revenue goals.

•	Assist in creating and streamlining standardised procedures for tracking venue revenue and producing weekly, quarterly and yearly reports.

•	Stay updated on hospitality, events and tourism industry trends and apply insights to improve operations and guest experiences.

•	Oversee resource planning with the Event Coordinator and Head Chefs to ensure optimal staffing, food and beverage availability.

•	Oversee key supplier and client agreements to maintain cost-effective and high-quality function services.

•	Oversee staff training programs to enhance service excellence and function operations.
Qualifications / Attributes

•	Must hold a Diploma in Hospitality Management or a relevant field, or at least three (3) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

•	Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience in function operations, hospitality management, or a similar role.

•	Demonstrated success managing function operations within large-scale hospitality businesses.

•	Strong leadership, organisational and stakeholder management skills.

•	Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

•	Experience managing budgets, operational reporting and venue performance.

•	Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences while driving operational success.

Salary Range

$75,000 – $90,000 per annum excluding superannuation.

result.description:
Location: 		Arundel, QLD, 4214
Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Reports to:		Workshop Foreman / Production Manager
Job Title: 		Carpenter
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a meticulous and experienced Carpenter with specialized expertise in fine cabinetmaking and custom joinery. This is a full-time, permanent position based in their modern Arundel workshop. The successful candidate will be integral to transforming architectural concepts into tangible, heirloom-quality installations. You will report directly to the Workshop Foreman and collaborate with a team of dedicated craftspeople and designers.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Design Interpretation & Material Preparation:
• Accurately analyse and interpret detailed technical drawings, CAD designs, and shop plans for custom cabinetry, complex joinery, and freestanding furniture.
• Plan and sequence the workflow, meticulously selecting appropriate timber species, veneers, laminates, and composite materials to meet exact design specifications and project timelines.

Precision Machining & Fabrication:
• Expertly operate a range of hand tools, power tools, and advanced workshop machinery including panel saws, thicknessers, routers, and CNC equipment to cut, shape, and prepare components.
• Fabricate bespoke cabinets, shelving units, countertops, and architectural millwork with exceptional attention to detail, adhering to tolerances within 1mm variance.

Expert Joinery & Component Assembly:
• Execute and implement advanced joinery techniques such as dovetail, mortise-and-tenon, and domino joinery to ensure both structural integrity and aesthetic appeal.
• Assemble components using specialized adhesives, fasteners, and clamping systems, guaranteeing seamless alignment, perfect squareness, and flawless integration of all parts.

Finishing, Detailing & Hardware Application:
• Skilfully apply veneers, laminates, and edge-banding to achieve invisible seams and pristine surfaces.
• Perform multi-stage sanding, staining, sealing, and finishing processes to produce a superior final coat as per client specifications, including matte, satin, or gloss finishes.
• Precisely install and calibrate high-end hardware such as soft-close hinges, drawer runners, and custom handles to ensure flawless operation and functionality.

Quality Assurance & Workshop Excellence:
• Conduct rigorous quality inspections of both raw materials and finished products, ensuring strict compliance with design intent, safety standards, and the company’s renowned quality benchmarks.
• Proactively identify and troubleshoot construction or fit issues, implementing effective corrective measures with a solutions-oriented mindset.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and highly organized workshop environment in line with 5S principles and all Work Health & Safety (WHS) regulations, including strict adherence to PPE protocols.

Skills & Experience Required:
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
• A formal qualification such as a Certificate III in Cabinet Making or Carpentry is essential.
• A minimum of 2 years of proven post-apprenticeship experience within a high-end commercial joinery, cabinetmaking, or furniture manufacturing workshop.
• Demonstrable portfolio showcasing experience with solid timber, veneers, and engineered board products.

Technical Proficiencies:
• High competency in traditional and modern joinery methods, precision machining, and hand-finishing techniques.
• Proven experience safely operating and performing basic maintenance on workshop machinery, including CNC routers and panel saws.

Personal Attributes:
• An unwavering eye for detail and a deep-seated pride in producing work of exceptional craftsmanship.
• A self-managed, proactive work ethic with strong problem-solving abilities and the initiative to work independently.
• Excellent communication skills and a collaborative spirit to work effectively with designers, project managers, and fellow tradespeople.
• The physical capability to perform manual tasks, including lifting materials up to 25kg, and standing for extended periods in a workshop setting.

What’s On Offer:
This is a exceptional opportunity for a passionate carpenter to advance their career with an industry leader. You will be provided with a permanent full-time role, a competitive remuneration package commensurate with experience, and the chance to work on prestigious projects with premium materials. You will join a supportive, skilled team in a well-resourced, modern facility.

Application Process:
If you are a craftsman dedicated to excellence and your skills align with this specialist role, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience through the provided application portal. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.
We are acting as an exclusive recruitment partner for this position. Please note that our client's company name has been withheld as per our agency agreement.

result.description:
If you thrive on finding solutions to everyday challenges, are client focussed and are keen to develop your career, then this role is for you!
For the right candidate this is an amazing opportunity to work with one of Australia’s leading professional engineering firms in an environment which encourages collaboration, communication and innovation.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced and passionate professional Structural Engineer to join our growing consultancy on a number of upcoming landmark projects.  Providing an exciting and challenging opportunity to enjoy exposure to a number of iconic and award-winning projects in both the public and private sectors. 
To be a part of our highly skilled multi-disciplinary team, you will use your technical expertise, building experience, creativity, and initiative to deliver smart, innovative and efficient engineering solutions to our clients. 
Using your excellent interpersonal and communication skills, you will also proactively develop and maintain relationships with current and prospective clients to support our continually expanding consultancy.  Salary range for this role is from $90,000. Base - $95,000. Base + superannuation. 

About You
You will be a degree qualified engineering professional with structural engineering experience, you will have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, an eye for detail and a passion for problem-solving. You should have firsthand experience designing and managing medium sized projects in the Australian market. This position offers exposure to a wide variety of projects, as well as career progression opportunities.
You will have:
•	An Australian tertiary engineering qualification;
•	local experience in structural engineering design;
•	Minimum 3 to 6 years’ experience in a consulting engineering office including a range of project types and sizes;
•	Demonstrated experience in commercial, residential, government and/or public buildings and retail;
•	Demonstrated experience in pre-stressing, steel design and reinforced concrete;
•	Knowledge and understanding of Australian regulatory requirements;
•	A can-do attitude and problem solver;
•	Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate well with senior management, clients and relevant authorities and build rapport and relationships;
•	Excellent attention to detail;
•	The ability to multi-task and work within a motivated and busy team;
•	The initiative to self-start and take control

Ideally you will also have:
•	Experience in RAM Concept, Microstran, STRAND 7, Revit and RAPT or similar programs (or the desire to learn!)
 
The Company
TTW employs over 500 staff across six offices in Australia and Asia. We are 100% locally owned and have been consulting engineers for over 65 years.
We deliver iconic and award-winning projects across Australia and the globe that pioneer engineering excellence. TTW’s vision is to forge strong relationships with our clients through the delivery of smart, innovative, and efficient engineering solutions.
We value:
Collaboration | Technical Excellence | A Personal Approach | Taking Initiative 

One TTW is our ethos, which encapsulates all the experienced, innovative and creative people that makes us who we are. Through a supportive and collaborative team environment, you will have the opportunity to develop your career with a company that cares about YOU.
Benefits
•	Real career development opportunities 
•	A flexible work environment including working from home
•	Ongoing training and development including paid study assistance 
•	Company paid parental leave
•	A robust social calendar 
We are an Equal Opportunities Employer and welcome applications from candidates of diverse backgrounds, including Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander people.
TTW does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies and is not responsible for any related fees.
Only applicants with full working rights will be considered for this role. 
Please apply with your current resume & cover letter via the “apply” button.  

Please note, TTW will never ask a candidate for any form of direct payment and all email correspondences from a TTW staff member will be sent from the official TTW domain email.

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Accommodation & Hospitality Manager to oversee the daily operations of our guest house accommodation business, specialising in privately managed short-stay holiday properties throughout Yamba, NSW.

This is a hands-on management role with a significant focus on housekeeping operations, property presentation and ensuring every guest enjoys an exceptional accommodation experience.

Key Responsibilities
Oversee the day-to-day operations of multiple guest house and private short-stay accommodation properties.
Plan, coordinate and supervise housekeeping activities to ensure all accommodation is cleaned, presented and maintained to a consistently high standard.
Develop cleaning schedules, inspection procedures and quality assurance processes to maintain guest satisfaction.
Recruit, train, supervise and support housekeeping and accommodation staff.
Prepare staff rosters and allocate duties to ensure operational efficiency.
Monitor accommodation occupancy, coordinate guest arrivals and departures, and ensure properties are ready for check-in.
Respond professionally to guest enquiries, requests, complaints and feedback, resolving issues promptly.
Monitor operational performance and implement improvements to service quality and efficiency.
Manage inventory levels for linen, amenities, cleaning products and other accommodation supplies.
Coordinate maintenance requirements with contractors to ensure all properties remain safe, functional and well presented.
Assist in preparing and monitoring operational budgets while managing expenditure and controlling operating costs.
Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, company procedures and accommodation standards.
Maintain accurate operational records, reports and housekeeping documentation.
Work closely with business owners to improve guest services, occupancy outcomes and overall business performance.

About You
Previous experience managing accommodation, guest houses, serviced apartments, hotels or short-stay holiday properties.
Demonstrated leadership experience supervising housekeeping or accommodation teams.
Strong organisational, communication and customer service skills.
Excellent attention to detail with a commitment to maintaining exceptional cleanliness and presentation standards.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
Relevant hospitality, accommodation management or business qualifications are highly regarded.

What We Offer
Full-time permanent position based in Yamba, NSW.
Salary of $70,000–$85,000 per annum plus superannuation, depending on qualifications and experience.
Supportive working environment with opportunities for professional development.
We are an eligible regional employer and welcome applications from candidates seeking employer sponsorship. Suitably qualified applicants interested in the Subclass 494 Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional) visa pathway are strongly encouraged to apply, as sponsorship may be available for the right candidate.

If you have a passion for accommodation management, exceptional housekeeping standards and delivering outstanding guest experiences, we welcome your application.

Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

# Graphic Design Apprentice

**Brendale, Brisbane QLD**
**Full-time Apprenticeship | Monday–Friday**

## Turn your creativity into a career.

Do you love design? Are you always creating artwork, experimenting with Adobe programs or finding yourself noticing great branding everywhere you go?

Velflex is one of Australia's leading manufacturers of custom heat transfers, supplying apparel decorators, sporting clubs, promotional product businesses and major brands across Australia and New Zealand.

We're looking for a **Graphic Design Apprentice** to join our experienced Graphics team in Brendale.

This is an incredible opportunity to gain a nationally recognised qualification while learning from experienced designers in a real production environment. You'll develop practical skills that can't be taught in a classroom, working on artwork that ends up on sportswear, uniforms, workwear, fashion and promotional products seen right across Australia.

If you're creative, motivated and excited to build a long-term career in graphic design, we'd love to hear from you.

## What you'll be learning

Working alongside our experienced Graphics team, you'll receive hands-on training in:

* Preparing customer artwork for production
* Creating and editing vector artwork using Adobe Illustrator
* Basic image editing in Adobe Photoshop
* Colour matching and artwork adjustments
* Setting up print-ready artwork files
* Understanding heat transfer and garment decoration production processes
* Digital printing workflows and production preparation
* Proofing artwork and quality control
* Managing multiple jobs and meeting production deadlines
* Working closely with our Sales, Customer Service and Production teams to achieve outstanding customer outcomes

As your skills develop, you'll have opportunities to contribute to customer artwork, branding projects, new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

## About you

We're looking for someone who is passionate about creativity and excited to learn.

You don't need years of experience—we'll provide full training—but you do need the right attitude and a genuine interest in graphic design.

You'll be a great fit if you:

* Have a genuine passion for graphic design and creativity
* Enjoy problem solving and thinking visually
* Have an excellent eye for detail
* Take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work
* Enjoy learning new software and skills
* Are organised and able to manage multiple tasks
* Communicate well and enjoy working with others
* Are reliable, motivated and eager to build a long-term career
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment

It would be great if you also have:

* Basic knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop (school, TAFE or personal projects all count)
* A portfolio of school work, personal projects or creative designs (not essential but highly regarded)
* Completed Year 12 (preferred but not essential)

## What you'll gain

This is much more than an apprenticeship.

You'll receive:

* A nationally recognised Graphic Design qualification
* Full on-the-job training and mentoring from experienced designers
* Experience using industry-leading Adobe Creative Cloud software
* Exposure to the latest digital print and garment decoration technology
* Real-world design experience from day one
* Opportunities to work on artwork for well-known Australian brands, sporting clubs and businesses
* A supportive team that genuinely wants to see you succeed
* Long-term career opportunities within a growing Australian company

## Why join Velflex?

Velflex is a proudly family-owned Australian business with a reputation for innovation, quality and exceptional customer service.

Our mission is to deliver industry-leading heat transfer solutions while helping our customers succeed through exceptional products, education and support.

Everything we do is guided by our core values of **Respect, Resilience, Trust, Honesty and Pride**.

When you join Velflex, you'll enjoy:

* A supportive, family-owned team culture
* Modern production and design facilities in Brendale
* On-site parking
* Barista-quality coffee every day
* Regular team BBQs, celebrations and social events
* Company uniforms provided
* Ongoing training and professional development
* Career progression opportunities as the business continues to grow

## Hours

This is a full-time apprenticeship based at our Brendale facility.

Standard hours are **Monday to Friday**, with training provided entirely on-site alongside our experienced Graphics team.

## Ready to start your creative career?

If you're passionate about design and want to turn that passion into a rewarding career, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply with your resume and a short cover letter telling us why you'd like to become a **Graphic Design Apprentice** at Velflex.

If you have a portfolio of school projects, personal artwork or creative work, we'd love to see it—but it's not essential.

Start your design career with a team that's passionate about creativity, innovation and helping people grow.
